title: Eval-driven CI/CD generation
statement: The system shall generate a GitHub Actions pipeline whose stages run the evals defined on stories.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: The workflow contains traceability, commit, acceptance, security, performance, deploy, post-deploy and monitor jobs
With a component, the workflow adds the PR impact comment and the verification gate before deploy
